description: This source file defines the GrainProperties class and related constants and interfaces related to grain metadata in Orleans. It includes mechanisms for representing grain properties, collecting properties via attributes, and managing well-known property keys.

classes.name: GrainProperties
classes.description: Immutable class representing grain type properties with a method for detailed string representation.

classes.name: WellKnownGrainTypeProperties
classes.description: Static class containing constants for well-known grain property keys.

classes.name: IGrainPropertiesProvider
classes.description: Interface for providing grain properties, typically through attributes.

classes.name: IGrainPropertiesProviderAttribute
classes.description: Interface for attribute classes that add properties to grain metadata.

classes.name: AttributeGrainPropertiesProvider
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainPropertiesProvider that gathers properties from attributes.

classes.name: IGrainBindingsProviderAttribute
classes.description: Interface for attribute classes that add binding information to grain metadata.

classes.name: AttributeGrainBindingsProvider
classes.description: Implementation of IGrainPropertiesProvider that gathers binding info from attributes.

methods.name: GrainProperties
methods.description: Constructor initializing properties and a method to generate a detailed string representation.

methods.name: ToDetailedString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation of the property dictionary.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method to add grain properties based on class attributes.

methods.name: GetBindings
methods.description: Method to retrieve binding information from attributes.
